hero_heading: Welcome to the studio of devrec.
hero_subtitle: Websites that impress. Results that matter.
about_tagline: Front-end Developer | Responsive · Accessibility · Performance · Progressive Enhancement
about_bio_1: I'm passionate about building digital experiences where responsiveness, accessibility, progressive enhancement, and performance are at the core.
about_bio_2: By combining design and technology, I strive to create user-friendly and future-proof solutions. Now looking to bring that mindset to a team where I can keep learning, refining my skills, and contributing to meaningful projects in web development.
service_1_desc: From design to live website. I build fast, modern and accessible websites that perform.
service_2_desc: Reliable hosting for your website or domain, so you're always online.
service_3_desc: Professional webshops with secure payments, inventory management and a seamless user experience.
service_4_desc: I analyse and optimise your existing website for speed, SEO and accessibility, with clear diagnoses and concrete improvements.
service_5_desc: Professional shoots for social media, campaigns or any personal purpose. From concept to final result.
faq_1_a: Costs depend on the complexity and your requirements. Get in touch for a no-obligation custom quote.
faq_2_q: How long does it take to build a website?
faq_2_a: An average website is ready within 2 to 4 weeks. Larger projects may take more time.
faq_3_q: Do you offer maintenance after delivery?
faq_3_a: Yes, I offer maintenance and updates after delivery. We can discuss a suitable maintenance contract.
faq_4_q: Can I have my existing website improved?
faq_4_a: Absolutely. I analyse your current website and come up with concrete improvements in speed, SEO and user experience.
faq_5_q: Do you also work with companies outside Amsterdam?
faq_5_a: Yes, I work remotely and collaborate with clients throughout the Netherlands and beyond.
contact_subtext: Got a project in mind? Send a message and I'll get back to you within 24 hours.
cookie_text: We use cookies for a better user experience and to analyse website visits.
